messages:
Dana: Quick thread to confirm customer comms and follow-up owners for the outage last night. Need short public text + who gets the full RCA.
Omar: I can draft the public blurb. Keep it <2 sentences: impact, mitigation, next step.
Lina: Ops confirmed window 00:18-00:52 UTC. ~12k retries, ~150 5xx. No auth/data exposure.
Priya: Legal note: public summary must state data exposure status. Full RCAs only to customers covered by contract/NDA; record approvals in the postmortem.
Dana: Suggested public copy: "Resolved: brief service degradation in us-west (00:180:52 UTC). Impact: elevated latency and intermittent failures. Mitigation: config rollback and cache persistence. No customer data exposed. Full RCA will be shared with affected contract customers after review."
Omar: Good. Add one short line: "Were scheduling a reliability review for recurring network flaps."
Lina: Ops will paste final counts into the postmortem and confirm the mitigation steps match.
Priya: Action items:
- Lina (Ops): paste timeline + metrics into postmortem (by 11:00 PT)
- Omar (Product): publish status page copy + customer email draft (by 17:00 PT)
- Support: prepare affected-customer list and distribution plan (by COB)
- Priya/Legal: review detailed RCA and approve distribution (by next business day)
Dana: Also: open infra follow-up ticket for recurring flaps (owner: Dana, due in 7 days).
ops-bot: Reminder: assign follow-ups in tracker https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4301/actions
Omar: Posting draft to #incidents-drafts now. Keep language neutral re: vendors.
Dana: Thanks all. Plan: public summary tonight; targeted RCAs to contracts after legal sign-off tomorrow. :thumbsup:
